name: L-System Garden
desc: A seed-grown L-system plant unfurling stroke by stroke and swaying in a continuous wind, brushed as tapered sumi ink with vermilion blossoms, or as a cyanotype schematic, neon filament, or charcoal smudge.

density.doc: L-system iterations / branch complexity (rebuilds the plant)

bloom.doc: fraction of branch tips that flower

hue.doc: foliage hue (blossoms sit at a complementary hue)

style.doc: aesthetic: tapered sumi brush on paper / white schematic contour on cyanotype (abstract) / additive glowing filament on near-black / soft charcoal smudge

act.doc: multi-minute program: grow unfurls and holds, wither cyclically advances then recedes, pulse breathes the canopy in and out

seed.doc: plant species (axiom/rules), branch angle, blossom placement
